speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent; I see you are a newborn presenting with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin. To determine the cause, how many weeks old are you, and was your pregnancy term normal or premature?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding-associated neonatal jaundice. The clinical picture of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with worsening jaundice and appropriate weight gain is classic for this benign condition. If you would like me to order specific lab tests or imaging, please let me know.
